sloka: एतान्निहन्तुमिच्छामि समरश्लाघिनो ह्यहम् ।एतैः प्रमथितं सर्वं दृश्यते राक्षसं बलम् ।। ६.५६.५ ।।।।
transliteration: etānnihantumicchāmi samaraślāghino hyaham ।etaiḥ pramathitaṁ sarvaṁ dṛśyate rākṣasaṁ balam ।। 6.56.5 ।।।।

translations.english: "I wish to see the end of Vanaras who boast of their warfare. The entire Rakshasa army is destroyed by them."
